items.title: Imgur blocks UK users after data watchdog signals possible fine
items.description: People in the United Kingdom are no longer able to access content hosted on the Imgur, a popular media sharing site, after a UK data watchdog warned it may impose a monetary penalty on the parent company, MediaLab. [...]

items.title: New China APT Strikes With Precision and Persistence
items.description: Phantom Taurus demonstrates a deep understanding of Windows environments, including advanced components like IIServerCore, a fileless backdoor that executes in memory to evade detection.

items.title: 'Klopatra' Trojan Makes Bank Transfers While You Sleep
items.description: A sophisticated new banking malware is hard to detect, capable of stealing lots of money, and infecting thousands of people in Italy and Spain.

items.title: Sendit sued by the FTC for illegal collection of children data
items.description: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is suing Sendit's operating company and its CEO for unlawful collection of data from underage users, as well as deceptive subscription practices. [...]

items.title: CISA Warns of Libraesva ESG Command Injection Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
items.description: In late September 2025, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) issued a public alert regarding the active exploitation of a critical command injection vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-59689 in Libraesva Email Security Gateway (ESG) devices. items.title: China Exploited New VMware Bug for Nearly a Year
items.description: A seemingly benign privilege-escalation process in VMware and other software has likely benefited attackers and other malware strains for years, researchers noted.

items.title: Threat Actors Hijacking MS-SQL Server to Deploy XiebroC2 Framework
items.description: A sophisticated attack campaign targeting improperly managed Microsoft SQL servers has emerged, deploying the XiebroC2 command and control framework to establish persistent access to compromised systems. The attack leverages vulnerable credentials on publicly accessible database servers, allowing threat actors to gain initial foothold and escalate privileges through a multi-stage deployment…

items.title: $50 Battering RAM Attack Breaks Intel and AMD Cloud Security Protections
items.description: A group of academics from KU Leuven and the University of Birmingham has demonstrated a new vulnerability called Battering RAM to bypass the latest defenses on Intel and AMD cloud processors.
